title: Analytics Tools & Solutions for Your Business - Google Analytics

facts.fact: Google Analytics is offered free of charge, per the vendor's page.
facts.quote: Google Analytics gives you the tools, free of charge, to understand the customer journey and improve marketing ROI.

facts.fact: According to Google's vendor-published Lider case study, Lider's use of Google Analytics produced an 85% decrease in CPA.
facts.quote: The result was an 85% decrease in CPA and 18X conversion rate improvement.

facts.fact: The vendor lists Google Analytics integrations with Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Display & Video 360, Google Cloud, and Google Search Console.
facts.quote: Google Ads Search Ads 360 Display & Video 360 Google Cloud Google Search Console
